"Build a fully interactive, web-based 2D Engine Simulator featuring a clean, sleek dark-blue UI theme (with deep blue background gradients, neon blue accents, and metallic/glassmorphism control panels). 

### Visuals @COMMENT_BODY@ Layout
- A stylized, animated cross-section view of a multi-cylinder engine (e.g., inline-4 or V8) rendered in real-time canvas/WebGL.
- Clear visualization of moving components: pistons, connecting rods, crankshaft, camshafts, valves opening/closing, and spark plug firing.
- Integrated particle/fluid dynamics overlay: visualize intake air velocity, fuel-air mixture turbulence inside the combustion chamber, and exhaust gas flow escaping through the headers, with color-shifting gradients (cool blue for intake, fiery orange/red for combustion and exhaust).

### Core Simulation Features @COMMENT_BODY@ Parameters
- Real-time interactive controls with sliders and input fields for:
  - RPM (idle to redline, e.g., 500 to 10,000+ RPM)
  - Throttle / Engine Load (%)
  - Compression Ratio
  - Ignition Timing (degrees)
  - Air-Fuel Ratio (AFR) @COMMENT_BODY@ Fuel Injection Pulsation
- Dynamic physics calculations for cylinder pressure, piston slap, valve float at high RPM, and frictional losses.

### Advanced Acoustic @COMMENT_BODY@ Audio Synthesis (Web Audio API)
- Procedural audio engine sound generator that synthesizes realistic engine notes instead of playing a looping sample.
- Fluid-coupled acoustics: pitch, frequency harmonics, and exhaust notes dynamically react in real-time to changes in RPM, load, throttle position, and chamber pressure.
- Simulates intake suction noise, valve train clatter, mechanical friction, and deep exhaust pulses.
- Real-time visualizer panels: an oscilloscope showing the raw audio waveform and a frequency spectrum analyzer (FFT) breaking down the acoustic signature.

### UI / UX Extras
- Collapsible HUD panels for \"Simulation Parameters\", \"Fluid Dynamics\", \"Acoustics\", and \"Diagnostics\".
- Presets menu to switch between engine types (e.g., High-Revving I4, Twin-Turbo V6, Deep V8).
- Audio master volume control and a toggle to record/export simulation audio.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

## Objective
- Build a complete, polished, web-based interactive 2D engine simulator with a dark-blue glassmorphism UI, animated engine cross-section, fluid particles, procedural Web Audio, FFT/oscilloscope visualizers, presets, diagnostics, and audio export.

## Requirements
- Stylized animated multi-cylinder cross-section: pistons, rods, crankshaft, camshafts, valves, spark plugs.
- Fluid overlay: intake air (cool blue), combustion turbulence (orange/red), exhaust headers.
- Controls: RPM 500–10,000+, throttle/load, compression ratio, ignition timing, AFR, injection pulsation.
- Dynamic physics: cylinder pressure, piston slap, valve float, friction losses.
- Procedural Web Audio (no loops) reacting to RPM/load/throttle/pressure; intake suction, valvetrain clatter, friction, exhaust pulses.
- Oscilloscope and FFT spectrum panels.
- Collapsible HUD panels: Simulation Parameters, Fluid Dynamics, Acoustics, Diagnostics.
- Presets: High-Revving I4, Twin-Turbo V6, Deep V8.
- Master volume and record/export simulation audio.
- Build immediately without clarifying questions; note assumptions when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (max 1280px wide) for checks and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Static vanilla HTML/CSS/ES modules; no package.json/framework.
- Chose I4 inline plus V6/V8 with paired angled banks and shared crank throws.
- Simulation is deterministic slider-crank + simplified thermodynamic pressure model; torque/power derived from BMEP estimate.
- Audio synthesized with oscillator/noise buses, compressor, analyser, MediaStreamDestination, MediaRecorder WebM export.
- Visualizer shows synthetic "SIGNAL PREVIEW" until audio is enabled; live analyser afterward.
- Audio starts on first non-audio-button gesture, or via audio/record buttons.
- Used local system fonts (Lato/DejaVu) to avoid network dependencies.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created full app structure: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/simulation.js`, `js/renderer.js`, `js/audio.js`, `js/app.js`.
- Implemented presets, physics state, UI controls, collapsible panels, flow toggles, keyboard shortcuts, toasts, diagnostics, cylinder pressure bars, warning flags.
- Implemented procedural audio engine with engine/exhaust/intake/valvetrain/friction/turbo buses, knock, volume/mute, MediaRecorder export.
- Implemented canvas engine rendering, particle systems, crankshaft, pistons, rods, cam/valve/spark details.
- Fixed major coordinate bug: cylinder head/liner Y values were absolute inside crank-local transforms; converted `deckY`, `bottomY`, `headTop` to local coordinates.
- Added adaptive V-bank angle so V6/V8 heads fit within cylinder spacing.
- Moved legend to top-left and audio hint to `bottom:80px`; hidden audio hint below 1160px.
- Reduced counterweight size and improved head/cam/valve/spark plug visuals.
- Removed large `shadowBlur` passes from block/piston rendering for performance.

### Active
- Verifying latest renderer changes and performance; previous measurement was ~22 FPS in headless software rendering, suspected from shadow blur, now removed.
- Need final visual review and responsive/mobile checks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Re-run `/tmp/opencode/check.mjs` against `http://localhost:3002` and inspect `screenshots/check.jpg`.
2. Confirm FPS recovered; if still low, profile/remove remaining expensive gradients or visualizer bar gradients.
3. Inspect V6 and V8 presets visually; ensure paired banks, heads, rods, and crank throws look correct.
4. Check mobile layouts at 390×844 and tablet ~900px.
5. Fix left rail overflow: Fluid Dynamics panel is currently cut off at 900px height; compact panel spacing or allow intentional scroll.
6. Tune initial hero power/torque values if too low; verify audio starts, recording exports, FFT/scope update.
7. Add favicon to remove 404 console error.
8. Run final screenshot checks and summarize assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: UI structure, panels, canvas, overlays.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full dark-blue glassmorphism design, responsive layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/simulation.js`: presets, physics, pressure/torque/diagnostics state.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/renderer.js`: canvas engine, particles, crankshaft/piston/head drawing.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: Web Audio synthesis, analyser, recording.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/app.js`: UI wiring, HUD, visualizers, keyboard, main loop.

- `/tmp/opencode/inspect.mjs`: geometry inspection script.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/check.jpg`: latest visual check image.

- Static server currently running on `http://localhost:3002` via `python3 -m http.server 3002` from project root.
- Playwright must launch with `executablePath: '/usr/bin/google-chrome'`, `headless: true`, `args: ['--no-sandbox']`; installed Chromium version mismatch otherwise.
